translations.EN: I heard you. You are bold, I will give you that.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Matapang ka, aaminin ko iyan.

translations.EN: I heard that romantic whisper. You have nerve.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang pahiwatig na 'yon. May lakas ka ng loob.

translations.EN: Heard loud and clear. That was daring of you.
translations.TL: Narinig nang malinaw. Matapang ang ginawa mong 'yan.

translations.EN: I caught your words. You certainly don't hold back.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko ang sinabi mo. Talagang di ka nagpipigil.

translations.EN: Heard you. That took some real courage to say.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Nangailangan ng tunay na tapang para sabihin 'yan.

translations.EN: I heard every word. You're bolder than most.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang bawat salita. Mas matapang ka kaysa karamihan.

translations.EN: I hear what you're hinting at. Quite bold.
translations.TL: Naririnig ko ang pahiwatig mo. Tunay na matapang.

translations.EN: Message heard. You definitely have guts.
translations.TL: Narinig ang mensahe. May tapang ka talaga.

translations.EN: I caught that soft line. Bold of you.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko ang malambing na linyang 'yon. Matapang ka.

translations.EN: Heard you. You know how to make an impression.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Marunong kang mag-iwan ng impresyon.

translations.EN: You certainly know how to get my attention.
translations.TL: Alam mo talaga kung paano kukunin ang pansin ko.

translations.EN: You definitely have my full focus after that.
translations.TL: Nasa sa 'yo na ang buong atensyon ko pagkatapos niyan.

translations.EN: You know just what strings to pull.
translations.TL: Alam mo kung anong kwerdas ang gagalawin.

translations.EN: You have a knack for turning my head your way.
translations.TL: May galing ka sa pagpihit ng tingin ko papunta sa 'yo.

translations.EN: You certainly know how to make me listen.
translations.TL: Marunong ka talagang magparinig sa akin.

translations.EN: That definitely caught my eye and ear.
translations.TL: Talagang nakuha niyan ang paningin at tainga ko.

translations.EN: You always find a way to make me look at you.
translations.TL: Lagi kang nakakahanap ng paraan para mapatingin ako sa 'yo.

translations.EN: Well, you have my complete attention now.
translations.TL: Nasa sa 'yo na ang buo kong atensyon ngayon.

translations.EN: You have a gift for captivating an audience.
translations.TL: May talento ka sa pang-aakit ng atensyon.

translations.EN: You know exactly what you're doing with those words.
translations.TL: Alam na alam mo ang ginagawa mo sa mga salitang 'yan.
